product_metadata.title: Tsingree 60L Waterproof Laundry Hamper, Large Foldable Laundry Basket with Leather Handles, Canvas Storage Bin for Kid's Room and Baby Nursery (2-Pack Grey Arrow)
features: Cotton Linen with PE coating interior for waterproof

PREMIUM QUALITY : The Laundry hamper is made of thickened premium cotton linen with waterproof coating interior, can stand its own well without any stuff in, and coming with 2 durable PU leather handles for long lasting use.
MULTI-PURPOSE ORGANIZER: The laundry hamper is designed to storage dirty clothes, and great to organize home textiles, toys, baby products and pet supplies.
LARGE CAPACITY: 19(H) *15.7(D) inches with capacity 60L, ,This laundry hamper is large enough to load a week’s worth of dirty clothes.
FOLDABLE: It can be quickly folded flat for space saving when not in use. Particularly useful for home storage, camping, college dorms, hotel, apartments and more.
SAFE FOR CHILDREN: No harmful materials included, and no bad smell. Comfortable and safe for storage in baby and kid's room.
